result.title: Structurally Separated DAG Learning with Multi-Scale Normalized Closure
result.summary: Continuous DAG learning commonly enforces acyclicity through scalar functions of a weighted adjacency that aggregate evidence from weighted closed walks. We add a complementary layer: matrix-valued closure logits---explicit multi-hop structural relation scores for each ordered pair---supervised alongside data fit, sparsity, and a DAGMA-style barrier on the weighted adjacency. The distinction is not scalarization of the overall objective but how path evidence is represented and exposed before aggregation. SMNC (scale-normalized multi-scale closure) builds these scores on a structural gate by repeated squaring in log space and divides each scale by its path-length budget, counteracting product-style attenuation along long cycles; diagonal entries support node-wise cycle supervision and off-diagonals optional pairwise reachability cues. In the linear model, a bounded structure--magnitude factorization ties strong effective edges to strong gates; a nonlinear induced gate offers another construction with the same intent. For sufficiently strong cycles, normalized logits admit a length-independent lower bound; under a unique-active-cycle assumption, the hard final-scale readout yields a polynomial log-gate gradient factor rather than exponential product-style decay. On cue-free, unstandardized Gaussian linear and nonlinear ER benchmarks, these models improve over DAGMA, run with default hyperparameters at a reduced budget, on denser graphs and are close to it on sparse ones.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在连续 DAG 学习中引入矩阵值 closure logits：在对数空间反复平方构造多跳结构关系分数，并按路径长度预算做尺度归一化，与数据拟合、稀疏项和 DAGMA 式 barrier 一并监督，在稠密 ER 图上以默认超参和改进预算取得相对 DAGMA 的提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「路径证据在聚合前如何被显式表示」以及长环下归一化 logits 给出长度无关下界的思路，可能为 LVR 中多跳关系证据的传递监督与长推理链梯度衰减提供可核查的方法线索，但与视觉或多模态推理无直接关联。
